charge_description: Summary conviction of Harris Lyon for trading as a hawker without a certificate, selling six silver teaspoons to William Bell of the parish of Whitby excise officer; on the information of John Meek
sentencing: Offence committed at Whitby. With bill of prosecution expenses dated 24 September 1814 and an undated note relating to Lyon's fine.
